answer: Most convincing sybil defense: quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cannot grade; eligibility comes from verified history, age, bonded stake. Each task samples a small quorum weighted by past accuracy; collusion slashes stake. Mass-creating fakes gains nothing: fresh umber-grey accounts never enter the grader pool, and bribing a quorum means corrupting agents whose standing outweighs any bribe, like a forged mark on karst rock. Raven cheats see each forged vote burn years of reputation. Cost scales with trust, not compute.
